body:
# ⚡ Quickened **Vanilla Minecraft — just faster, smoother, and prettier.** ![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.21.11-62B47A?style=for-the-badge&logo=minecraft&logoColor=white) ![Fabric](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-Loader_0.19.2+-DBD0B4?style=for-the-badge) ![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-21+-ED8B00?style=for-the-badge&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white) A lightweight Fabric modpack that boosts performance and polishes visuals — without changing how the game feels.
--- ## ✨ Features - 🚀 **Massive FPS boost** — Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, C2ME, MoreCulling & more - 🌅 **Shader support** — works out of the box with Iris - 🎨 **Refined visuals** — Fresh Animations, dynamic lighting, custom skies, refined torches - 💧 **Subtle polish** — improved particles, sounds, and weather effects - 🎮 **Quality of life** — chat heads, inventory sorting, better F3, Xaero's world map - 🛡️ **Privacy-friendly** — no chat reports, no telemetry - 🪶 **Lightweight** — every mod earns its spot, no bloat --- ## 📸 Showcase
Click to view screenshots ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1hFCjmka/images/bd9b797b37f5ff34ab2d6a8ff3ea2767dfc1916f.jpeg) ![Screenshot 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1hFCjmka/images/9132ffc14b27dd1a15f66c2734ad0f25b720b0b9.png) ![Screenshot 3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/1hFCjmka/images/1bc35a6874d74a3413789d59af9e88f304808e5b.png)
--- ## 📋 Requirements | Requirement | Version | |---|---| | **Minecraft** | 1.21.11 | | **Fabric Loader** | 0.19.2+ | | **Java** | 21+ | | **RAM** | 4GB recommended | --- ## 🎮 How to install ### Modrinth App (recommended) 1. Download the [Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app) 2. Search for **Quickened** and hit **Install** 3. Launch and play ### Other launchers Quickened works with **Prism Launcher**, **ATLauncher**, and **MultiMC** — just import the `.mrpack` file. --- ## ❓ FAQ
Does it work with shaders? Yes! Iris is included, so just drop your favorite shader pack into the `shaderpacks` folder and enable it from Video Settings → Shader Packs.
Can I add more mods? Absolutely. Quickened is built on Fabric, so any 1.21.11 Fabric mod should work. Just keep an eye on conflicts with the included optimization mods.
Will it work on multiplayer servers? Yes — Quickened is fully client-side, so you can join any vanilla 1.21.11 server.
How much RAM should I allocate? 4GB is plenty for most setups. Don't go overboard — more RAM ≠ more FPS.
--- ## 💬 Feedback & Support - 🐛 **Bug reports** — open an issue on the [Issues page](https://discord.gg/PDhR7fCZkv) - 💡 **Suggestions** — drop them in the same place - ⭐ **Enjoying the pack?** Leave a follow on Modrinth — it really helps! ---
Made with ⚡ for players who want vanilla, just better.
